fx.source_title: Tasa de cambio representativa del mercado (TRM)
fx.comparability_warning: A single TRM date makes the envelope reproducible. It is not a procurement FX clause.

cpi.source: DANE, Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC)
cpi.source_title: IPC — variación anual y factores de actualización usados para normalizar presupuestos a julio 2026
cpi.method: Chain official annual IPC factors onto the source-year amount, then apply the January–July 2026 factor.
inclusions: National IPC chain used only to place historical COP budgets on a July 2026 price date
cpi.comparability_warning: National IPC is a price-date normalizer, not a local construction cost index for Comuna 8.

design_allowance.source_title: Design Well, Build Better: A Guide for Planning, Creating, Overseeing and Making Decisions about Social Infrastructure Designs
design_allowance.quantity_basis: design as a share of construction, not a lump sum
inclusions: Pre-feasibility design allowance used until a 30% design exists
design_allowance.comparability_warning: IDB design-share guidance is not a Medellín fee schedule.

drainage_corridor_length_m.note: Planning-cell width is 80 m. Corridor length is not surveyed; these are named pre-feasibility length scenarios, not geometry.

rwh_usd_per_system.note: Planning range around the 2026-normalized Santa Elena ceiling. Not an awarded Comuna 8 price.

restoration_usd_per_package.note: Conceptual project-scale range around the CPI- and TRM-normalized DAGRD Comuna 8 package. Not a USD/m² rate.
